column3: Sat handy behind the front group - 5th at halfway - urged forward into 4th with 2f left - up to 2nd inside the final furlong - hit the front close home and stayed on strongly to win
Sat close to front group early - moved into third with 2f left - pushed to front inside final furlong - lost front spot close home and stayed on same effort to finish 2nd
Tracked the pace early - third turning halfway - dropped to fifth and driven with two furlongs left - fought back in the closing strides to snatch third
Sat behind the front group - moved into second by halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little in third - eased back to finish 4th
Made the running - hard at work turning in - challenged and gave way over 1f out - faded to finish fifth
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with over 2f left - stayed on at one gear from inside the final furlong - finished 6th
Held up towards the back - urged into contention approaching 2f out - responded and stayed on inside the closing stages - finished seventh
Towards the back - made ground into midfield 2f out - one-paced inside the final furlong to finish 8th
Held up towards the back - driven wide over 2f out - crept on late inside the final furlong - well held in 9th
Settled around midpack - unable to threaten the front end approaching final 2f - eased off the pace to the line
Sat close to the front pack early - midfield turning for home - urged on entering the straight - lost touch with no response inside final furlongs
Held up in the pack - moved into contention over 3f out - then found nothing and dropped away before the home straight - finished well held in 12th
Settled towards the back early - moved into contention by halfway - asked for effort in 7th spot over 2f out but found nothing more - dropped away final furlong to finish 13th
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort passing 3f out - had little response and dropped away before entering straight - finished well beaten in 14th
Held up at the back - unable to make an impression - well held throughout
Held up near back - crept into the pack 4f out - dropped away over 3f out - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - settled behind the pace - hit the front with a furlong left drifting right - stayed on to win
Fought for control early - up alongside pace-setter soon after - drifted off a true line under a furlong out - fully involved into the last but denied narrowly and battled to the line
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command inside the last two furlongs - dropped to third and held no more in the closing stages
Held a midfield berth early - asked for more three furlongs out but couldn't quicken and lost touch with the pace inside the final furlong and a half - kept going for fourth
Settled towards the back - stayed on late from 1f out - unable to challenge the front runners - finished fifth
Settled in the pack - lost touch approaching 2f out - beaten some way out - came home in 6th
Tardy start - pulled hard but never off the back of the field - struggling badly and allowed to coast home 1f out
Sat close to the pace early - backed off the tempo 6f out - quickly withdrawn from contention
Settled towards the back early - stumbled after brushing heels of another runner and lost rider soon after
Tracked the front-runner early - still in second at halfway - asked for effort turning into the straight - hit the front a furlong out and stayed on to win
Sat close to the front group early - moved into 5th 2f out then pushed up into 3rd with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch 2nd in the closing strides

Settled towards the back and travelled with plenty of enthusiasm early on - swept into command after 2f - driven approaching the straight - overtaken a furlong from home and had nothing more to offer - slipped to third close home

Went straight to front - lost advantage before 2f - sat 3rd by halfway - urged into effort with 2f remaining - driven back through into 5th inside final furlong before finding late response to snatch 4th
Sat handy behind the pace - moved into 3rd approaching 2f out then pressed on but flattened out in 4th with a furlong left - edged back to finish 5th
Sat close to the front group early - midfield past halfway then nudged for effort inside final quarter mile - driven late to move into 6th finishing well held
Sat close to the pace early - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left and slipped to 6th inside final furlong - dropped back again through the run-in to finish 7th
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - unable to quicken and finished without change of gear - well held in 8th
Held a midfield spot - urged forward with 3f left - unable to gain ground - well beaten in 9th
Held up in the pack early - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - dropped away with 4f left - well held at the finish
Slow to break - held up towards the back - made no impression - finished well beaten in 12th
Held up towards the back - unable to make progress from over 2f out - well beaten in 13th
Held up in the pack early - made no impression through the contest - well beaten in 14th
Close up early - hit front two out - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on well inside it - edge narrowed near line but hung on to win
Sat behind the pace - moved right approaching final furlong - took second place close home - kept on to be narrowly denied
Settled towards the back early - squeezed through for room and made progress inside the final furlong - finished strongly to grab third right on the line
Settled towards rear - advanced into contention from the final furlong - moved up to third late on before finishing fourth
Handy in the pack - moved right approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish 5th beaten 2¼ lengths
Set the pace early - lost command approaching final two furlongs - faded inside closing stages - finished sixth
Sat close to the front group pulling hard - drifted right approaching the last furlong then drifted left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 7th
Took a strong hold early - settled near the back of the field - drifted left inside the final furlong with no real threat to leaders

Settled midfield early - moved through to the front after the opening furlong - challenged hard with 2f remaining - pushed along and overtaken a furlong out - slipped back to third with 200 yards left before fighting back to score right on the line
Held up towards the back - moved through to challenge over 2f out and hit the front approaching the furlong pole - then found nothing more and was caught in the final strides to finish second
Handy behind front group - up to 3rd approaching 2f out - driven and stayed on same gait late to finish 3rd
Up with the front group - under pressure from 2f out - found a little when momentarily squeezed for space late on and took 4th in the final strides
Settled near the back - driven on the rail approaching 2f out - stayed on into 5th from a furlong out

Sat just behind the front group early - moved into second by halfway - asked for effort to loom up with 2f left - nudged into the advantage inside the final furlong but overtaken 200 yards out - had nothing left and dropped away near the line
Up with the front group - driven into 5th over 2f out before finding nothing and fading in the closing stages
Went straight to the front - overtaken before the 1f marker - urged into 4th spot approaching 2f out - squeezed for space inside the final furlong then found nothing and dropped away near the finish
Slow to begin - asked for effort with over 2f left - responded only modestly late on to close inside final furlong - finished 9th
Settled at the back early - made no impression through the race - finished well held in 10th
Settled midfield early - urged forward approaching final 2f - unable to close from over 1f out - finished well held in 11th
Held up towards back of pack - made no headway from 3f out - well held at finish
Held up at the back throughout - no impression made on leaders - finished well held in 13th
Sat close behind front group early - 6th at halfway - asked for effort 3f out but had nothing more and dropped away
Drifted right and knocked at the off - set the pace almost throughout - pushed along inside final 2f - went on well to hold off rivals and won
Held a midfield position early - moved up but drifted left approaching the final furlong - into second close home - stayed on to finish second without threatening the winner
Knocked at the break - up with the pace early - tracking the front group - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - stayed on late to grab third
Drifted right at the outset - tracked front pack - pushed along a furlong out and gave up third spot late
Hemmed in early - held a midfield spot through the race - stayed on without gaining much ground inside final two furlongs to finish 5th beaten 3.75L
Sat close to the pace from early on - dropped to third approaching the closing stages - unable to find more late on - finished sixth beaten 4 lengths
Sluggish start - settled towards back pulling hard - shifted right entering straight then drifted right approaching final furlong - no real threat - finished seventh
Squeezed for space at the break - settled towards the back - angled left with a furlong left - progress checked by lack of room and unable to threaten late
Jumped the break awkwardly at the off - held up towards the back of the field throughout - finished well held in 9th
Set the pace from the break - challenged hard inside final furlong and a half - dug in to hold on at the finish

Held up towards back of pack - asked to improve and move up behind front group entering straight - moved through on outside to take second spot inside final furlong - chased the front-runner from 150 yards but couldn't find more late

Sat behind the front group early - urged forward entering straight and in 4th passing the furlong marker - stayed on well inside final furlong to take 3rd close home - finished third beaten 2.5 lengths
Sat just behind the front group - asked for effort turning into the straight - still in 6th with 2f left - stayed on late to snatch 4th near the line
Held up towards back of the pack - driven into contention entering the straight and stayed on at one gear from over a furlong out - finished 5th late
Sat close to the pace early - 5th at halfway - driven up into 3rd over 2f out but couldn't find more - dropped away in the closing stages
Sat close to the front pack early - asked for effort over 2f out but found little in 4th with a furlong to go - lost ground late to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with over 2f left - stayed under pressure and edged forward only slightly inside the closing furlong - finished 8th
Sat close to front group early - urged forward in the pack as straight was reached - unable to threaten from over 2f out - finished ninth well held
Held up towards back of pack - unable to make headway from over 2f out - well held at finish
Tracked the pace-setter early - disputed second at halfway - urged into the effort with 2f left - no response and dropped away inside the final furlong
Slow into stride - held up in the pack throughout - no real impression made - finished well beaten in 12th
Settled around midfield early - dropped towards the back by halfway - unable to close from over 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - asked for effort with 3f left - unable to close from there - well beaten in 14th
Settled at the back early - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack early - motored home wide from the last bend to hit the front inside the final furlong - pulled clear to score

Checked and hesitant leaving stalls - settled towards back and fighting for control early - squeezed for space approaching final 2f - moved left for room and made ground a furlong out - stayed on well inside the closing furlong - nabbed second place right on the line - unable to reel in winner

Sat behind front group - angled right approaching final two furlongs - moved into second - hit the front for a moment inside the last furlong - couldn't match the winner's finishing kick and edged out of the frame close home
Handy early - hit the front 3f out - pushed along with 2f left before giving way inside final furlong - couldn't find more late to finish 4th
Sat behind front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left and again inside the final furlong - unable to close in the closing stages finishing fifth
Fidgety before the off - settled midfield through the race - pushed along under 2f out but unable to close - finished well held in 6th
Sluggish start - held up at the back throughout - never involved - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - moved up and eased off the rail 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Fought for control early - up front until overtaken 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th

Up at the head of affairs early - lost the advantage 4f out and settled up with the two ahead - driven and shaken up over 2f out - regained the initiative 1f out - pulled comfortably into the open to win

Settled in the pack early - driven approaching final two furlongs - kept on well inside the final furlong - moved into second late but unable to peg back the winner - finished second beaten 2¼ lengths
Bumped a touch at the break - travelled well on the outside - asked for effort and closed on the front-runner 2f out - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Slow to break - held towards the back - driven approaching final furlong and stayed on - finished without getting closer than fourth
Held in midfield - urged for effort with over 2f left - couldn't quicken - finished 5th
Handy early tracking leading group - driven and lost touch over 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish sixth
Drifted right at the break - settled up with pace - hit front 4f out - come under pressure and challenged 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong and dropped away
Settled at back - driven approaching halfway - never a threat thereafter - finished eighth

Settled midpack early - dropped back near halfway - urged into effort entering the straight - asked for more 2f out - moved through on the outside to third with a furlong left - stayed on to hit the front late and win

Held up towards the back early - improved into midfield by halfway - up into 4th with 2f left - pushed into 2nd inside final furlong - hit the front 200 yards out before being reeled in and beaten a neck late

Sat behind the front group early - moved through to hit the front after a furlong - urged forward approaching 2f out - driven and matched stride for stride inside the final furlong - gave way in the last 200 yards to finish third
Set the pace early - overtaken before the furlong mark - settled third by halfway - squeezed for room and asked for effort with 2f left - found running late to snatch fourth close home
Sat behind the front group early - urged forward into the straight and asked to press on over 2f out - had nothing more to give and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up at the back - no impression made - finished sixth
Held up in the pack from the start - no impression made - finished well held in 7th
Sat behind pace early - still second at halfway - into the drive turning in and third under pressure over 2f out - held no more in reserve and dropped away over 1f out
Set the pace from the start - pressed for effort inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Sat behind the pace - moved right and improved to second inside the last furlong - stayed on well to finish second beaten a short head
Sat close to leader - pushed along a furlong out then dropped to third late - held on without finding more in the closing stages
Settled midpack early - shifted right approaching final turn while pushing on then up to fourth inside final furlong - unable to reach front and finished 4th
Dwelt at the break - settled last of the group - made progress a furlong out - moved right inside the final furlong - stayed on well to close down the field at the line
Squeezed for room and sluggish into stride - settled in the pack pulling hard - improved and drifted left approaching final furlong - faded close home to finish sixth
Settled towards back of the pack - roused with two furlongs left - stayed on out wide inside the final 110 yards but no real threat
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left and found a bit of extra pace inside the final furlong then lost momentum close home
Drifted right and hesitant into stride - held up towards the back through the race - finished 9th
Squeezed for space at the off and hesitant to begin - stayed towards the back for the remainder - finished well held in 10th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished 11th
Sat close to the front group early - lost ground under pressure 2f out - drifted left and dropped away inside final furlong - finished 12th
Set the pace throughout - driven with two furlongs left and asked for more with one to go as a rival loomed - dug in to prevail by a whisker
Nudged right leaving the stalls - up with the front group - driven 2f out - ran on powerfully into the final furlong and grabbed second on the line - just failed to catch the winner by a short head
Handy early - driven approaching final furlong to challenge hard - kept battling but nabbed for second right on the line
Sat close to pace early - asked for effort 2f out - weakened inside final furlong to finish 4th
Settled midpack - urged with more than a furlong left - unable to find extra - held on for fifth
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held throughout
Settled midpack towards the wide side - moved up into third by halfway point before edging into contention 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong
Slow to begin - held up towards the back - never involved - finished eighth
Drifted right early - settled midfield - driven approaching halfway then faded over a furlong out
Sat just behind the pace - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - moved into 2nd inside final furlong before getting up to score late

Held up towards back of the pack - urged forward entering the straight - moved into contention approaching 2f out - sent to the front with a furlong left - challenged hard in the closing stages and just failed to hold on
Settled in the pack early - given a squeeze for effort with over 2f left - responded and moved up into 3rd inside the final furlong

Went straight to front - overtaken after a furlong - sat third at halfway - up into fourth and going smoothly with over 2f left - moved to the rail approaching final furlong - pushed along and unable to quicken finishing 4th
Held up in the back markers - driven with over 2f out and squeezed for space approaching the final furlong - moved to the outside and stayed on late to finish 5th
Sat behind the front group early - disputed second at halfway - urged forward turning in and asked to close 2f out - had nothing left and drifted right approaching final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to the front pack early - urged into third with 2f left then flattened out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Towards the rear early - driven up to front after 1f - challenged hard over 2f out then found nothing over 1f out - fading when bumped over 1f out and finished eighth
Held up towards the back - couldn't land a blow from over 2f out - faded to finish well held
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
Settled around midfield - urged forward with 3f left - unable to quicken and dropped away inside final furlong - eventually well held
Held up at the back - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Tracked pace throughout - moved through to dispute inside final two furlongs - hit front and driven approaching last furlong - edged clear before easing to hold on for the win
Went straight to front - drifted right coming off the turn - challenger arrived close behind - overtaken with a furlong left - fought back in the closing stages but denied by a short margin
Sluggish start - settled last but not far off - made progress from 2f out - up to third inside final furlong but unable to trouble the leading two
Handy early - fighting for a stronger grip - drifted right turning for home - lost touch and dropped away close home
Sluggish start - pulled hard while settled towards the back - never a threat and finished 5th
Settled with the pack early - pushed along wide 3f out - lost ground soon after - eventually well held in 6th
Up with the pace in second - urged forward approaching 2f out - moved to the front inside the final furlong and pulled well ahead to win
Sat close behind leading duo - urged forward outside final 2f - stayed on to claim runner-up spot but unable to reel in winner
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort with a furlong to run and lost the advantage - kept going without finding extra to finish third
Settled midfield - dropped away and pushed along over 2f out - fought back inside final furlong but held for 4th
Drifted right at the break - settled midfield then found room to fourth approaching 2f out - kept going without extra late gear to finish fifth
Held up in midfield - driven with over two furlongs left - lost place inside final furlong - eventually finished sixth beaten well over six lengths
Tracked the front group early - hampered by a loose horse after two furlongs - dropped towards the back - unable to make further impression - finished seventh
Slow into stride and knocked at the off - held up in the pack thereafter - never a factor - finished 8th
Held up towards the back - urged forward around halfway - dropped away from the pack inside the final 2f - finished well beaten in 9th
Ducked sideways as gates sprang - rider dislodged before race began
Settled behind pace - third at halfway - squeezed for room approaching 2f out then edged left brushing another runner - hit front inside final furlong under urging - stayed on strongly to prevail

Sat behind front group early - moved into second by halfway - edged in front two furlongs out - driven along and matched stride for stride inside the final furlong - could not find more and passed close home - battled on without changing gear to finish second
Sat behind the front group - urged into 4th approaching 2f out then found third spot inside final furlong - held on one-paced to finish 3rd
Settled towards the back of the pack early - improved into 6th by halfway - asked for effort over 2f out and stayed on inside the final furlong - moved into 4th around 150 yards out
Held up towards the back - urged forward from 2f out and stayed on well from inside final furlong - moved into 5th near the line
Settled around midfield - urged forward to lead momentarily before fading into 4th after being knocked about a furlong out - dropped further back close home to finish sixth
Sat close to front group early - slipped through the field by the midpoint - unable to close from 2f out - finished seventh well held
Held up in the pack - driven approaching 2f out - unable to find further response inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - made no impression - well held in 9th
Set the pace early - driven to keep going before losing front spot inside final 2f - had nothing more to offer and dropped away from over 1f out - finished well held in 10th
Settled up in second early - hit the front after a furlong - opened up the field from inside the final furlong and a half - eased through the line in command
Held up in the pack - moved through 2f out to third - pushed into second inside the last furlong - pressed the leader close home - unable to find extra and beaten into 2nd
Went straight to the front - overtaken after a furlong - pressed for effort with a furlong left - stayed on into third behind the top two
Settled close to pace early - still up with the front around 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Handy with the front group early - driven approaching final furlong then lost touch - stayed on same gait to finish fifth
Sluggish start leaving group at the tail - stuck for space approaching 2f out - drifted left with a furlong left - faded in a hurry inside final furlong to finish sixth
Held mid-pack early - urged forward approaching halfway then driven with a furlong left - faded in the closing stages to finish seventh
Close to the pace early - driven approaching final 2f - dropped away inside last furlong and beaten well into eighth
Dwelt at the break - dropped to the back of the field - made ground before halfway - lost momentum 2f out - faded into the final furlong to finish 9th
Held up towards the back - slipped to last by halfway and found little - lost touch inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Led throughout - driven approaching final furlong and a half - kept on strongly to the line
Slow to break - settled midpack - urged into contention 2f out - up to fourth with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch second near the line without threatening the winner
Handy early - urged into action approaching final 2f - unable to match front-runner inside final furlong and finished third one-paced
Sat close to front group early - urged forward with 2f left - unable to close the gap - finished fourth
Tracked the front group early - pushed along a furlong from home - weakened close to the line to finish fifth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - driven approaching final furlong - shaped up late but not a factor
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - unable to find any headway - eventually beaten well over six lengths in 7th
Held up towards the back - asked for effort with 2f left - found little
Squeezed for space and nearly went down early on - settled towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away 2f out - finished ninth
Held up towards back - never involved - well beaten in 10th
Held up in the pack - driven for effort - dropped away with two furlongs left - well held at the finish
Sat just behind the front group on the inside - asked for effort 2f out but knocked sideways and dropped back - unable to make up the deficit - eventually well held in 12th

Hesitant start - settled towards back and lost touch with field before halfway - driven into contention from 2f out - drifted middle of track and stayed on well approaching final furlong - hit front close home - battled to prevail
Up with the pace throughout - moved to the front entering the final 110yds - battled hard but caught near the line and went down by a short head
Made the running - pressed for effort a furlong out then lost command close home - lost more ground to finish third
Settled 4th - nudged for effort inside the final furlong - stayed on without the gears to threaten for a place

Up with the pace in the middle of the track - nudged forward to close on the front group over 1f out - fell away sharply inside the final furlong and was allowed to coast home fifth beaten 12.5 lengths
Held a midpack position early - asked for effort inside final two furlongs but lost touch - dropped away rapidly with a furlong left - trailed home well beaten in 6th
Urged forward early - settled near the back - slipped to the tail 2f out and finished well adrift
Sat behind pace - driven approaching final 2f and reeled in gap - hit front inside final 110yds and edged home
Sat close to pace early - asked for effort 2f out and found more late to move into second - narrowly missed catching winner
Went straight to front - opened a big gap by halfway - advantage cut down inside the final furlong under urging - overtaken close home - unable to find more
Tardy away - dropped to the back and driven up from 3f out - sharing second spot 2f out - kept on at one speed to finish fourth
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to find any headway - finished 5th
Held up towards the back - given encouragement approaching halfway - dropping away with 2f left - finished sixth
Settled around midpack early - dropped away and asked for effort 3f out - held no chance from 2f out - finished 7th well beaten
Handy early - into second before halfway - challenged front-runner 3f out - moved ahead soon after - drifted left approaching final 2f - driven out and kept up the finish to score
Handy early with the pace - moved into second place 2f out - pressed the winner from the furlong marker - stayed on but couldn't find more late to finish second
Hampered at the break - settled in the pack - urged forward with a furlong left - fought for third before edging away to hold the spot at the finish
Bumped at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along to close ground inside the final furlong and briefly involved for third - stayed on without further gain to finish fourth
Drifted left at the break - held a forward position - driven up to challenge the front group 2f out - lost ground over 1f out - faded late to finish fifth
Hesitant leaving stalls - held up towards the back - driven up into contention two out - squeezed for space and lost ground inside the last
Held up towards the back - shifted across to press forward two furlongs out - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish seventh
Knocked at the break - went straight to the front - lost command 3f out - lost touch with the pace 2f out - dropped away rapidly to finish last of all
Driven early to hold a spot on the outside - hit front after 4f - urged with 2f remaining - responded and driven out final furlong - held on for the win
Settled in the pack early - crept forward on the outside with 3f left - driven up to second with 2f to run - stayed on but unable to challenge the winner - beaten just over a length in second
Slow to start - held towards back of field - driven into contention with 2f left - up to fourth a furlong out - kept on to finish third
Advanced to front early - lost front spot passing 4th furlong - sat close up behind pacesetter - urged forward with 2f left and kept up effort to the line finishing fourth
Held up at the back - improved from over 2f out under pressure - stayed on same gear inside final furlong - finished 5th
Handy early - driven and dropped back 2f out - stayed on without threatening - finished sixth beaten 2½ lengths
Sat handy behind front group - urged forward with 2f to run - lost ground in the closing stages - finished seventh
Hampered start - settled towards the back of the field - pushed along with 3f left but couldn't quicken - finished well held in 8th
Settled close up early - drifted into the pack after four furlongs - asked for effort 2f out but had nothing left - well held in 9th
Went straight to front - overtaken shortly after - tracked the pack through the middle stages - driven with over a furlong left and soon faded

Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front over 2f out - driven up and edged in front briefly entering the final furlong - found more inside the last 110yds to regain command - held on to prevail
Sat in third early - moved up into second with 2f left then went ahead inside the last - couldn't find more once challenged and just failed by a short margin
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - eased into contention late and moved into third close home - never able to trouble the front two at the finish
settled towards the back - improved to third 2f out - pressed for effort inside the final furlong - faded close to home to finish fourth
Set the pace early - overtaken approaching 2f out and faded fast into last - trailed home well beaten in 5th
Led throughout - repelled a bid for the lead approaching final furlong and needed urging - driven out inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to draw clear close home
Held up in the pack - made ground on the inner to sit third 2f out - kept on well under pressure to claim second near the line

Handy on the rail early - asked for effort with 2f left and shot up alongside the pacesetter - still firmly in contention approaching the final stages - flattened out inside the last 110 yards and edged out of second near the line
Held a wide midpack berth - roused with two furlongs left - rallied through the closing stages to round out fourth without threatening the placings
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - weakened inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up at the back - driven with over 2f out - stayed on late for 6th
Held up at the back - urged forward with over 2f to run - unable to make an impression - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - driven approaching 2f out - failed to feature - finished 8th
Held up handy on the wide side - squeezed for pace and slipped back nearing 2f out - faded meekly through the closing stages to finish 9th
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - made progress from 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - surged clear approaching the line to score

Settled midpack early - improved to chase the pacesetter with 2f left - showed inexperience upon reaching the front a furlong out - pushed along inside the last - caught close home and unable to find more
Held a forward spot early - settled third - urged into the advantage approaching the final furlong for a moment - lost that edge soon after - stayed on into third close up inside the final 110yds
Went straight to front - clear on own around the far rail - overtaken with a furlong left before fading close home
Hampered leaving the stalls - made ground from well back from 1f out - stayed on without threatening
Went forward on the near flank early - dropped away over a furlong out - faded in the closing stages to finish sixth
Hampered for room at the off - held up in the pack - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 7th
drifted right early - settled mid-pack - urged forward approaching halfway - lost ground over a furlong out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish eighth
Settled in the pack - urged forward and made ground wide with a furlong left - hit the front inside the final 110 yards to score

Held up early - moved to the outside and improved into contention approaching the final 3f - up to third with 2f left - eked into a slender advantage nearing the final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to fight back
Sat behind the leading duo - asked for effort 3f out - kept going late but lacked the speed to get on terms - finished third
Set the pace early - urged forward with over a furlong left before being overtaken nearing the last furlong - faded quickly after
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - never able to close - finished well beaten in 5th
Up with the front group - took a strong hold the whole way - fell back over 2f out and beaten 12 lengths into 6th
